info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Open Banking Event Notification-spec
info.description: The Open Banking Event Notification API facilitates the creation of event notifications related to banking transactions and activities. This endpoint allows consumers, such as financial institutions and third-party developers, to submit event notifications in a standardized format. By utilizing this API, clients can ensure timely updates and alerts for end-users, enhancing the overall banking experience. This API streamlines communication processes and fosters a more integrated financial ecosystem.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an event notification, which can be utilized to notify subscribers about important events or updates. It accepts the necessary details in the request body and will respond with the status of the creation process.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information for processing event notifications. It must adhere to the specified schema to ensure proper operation and integration with the event notification system.
